title: Permutation Matrix Representation for Quantum Simulation: Comparative Resource Analysis
summary: We present a comparative study of the permutation matrix representation (PMR) method for Hamiltonian simulation alongside other leading quantum algorithms. Our analysis focuses on resource costs for simulating both time-independent and time-dependent Hamiltonians. For the time-independent case, we benchmark PMR against quantum signal processing (QSP) and qubitization, using the Rydberg interaction Hamiltonian as a representative example.
